name: Cloudflare
one_liner: Cloudflare is an internet infrastructure platform with a REST API, OAuth clients, and MCP server hosting.
auth_notes: API tokens created in the dashboard grant API access. OAuth clients are supported for third-party apps, using Authorization Code (with a client secret, or with PKCE for public clients).
access_notes: API tokens are created in the dashboard. OAuth client creation requires the Super Administrator, Administrator, or OAuth Client Write role. Public OAuth clients need DNS-based domain verification. No cost is stated in the fetched pages.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve API tokens and a documented REST API with standard token auth. Endpoint breadth, rate limits, cost, and any official API MCP server are not in the fetched pages.

auth.quote: Create an API token to grant access to the API to perform actions.
Cloudflare does not support Client Credentials, Implicit, Resource Owner Password Credentials, Device Authorization, or other OAuth grant types for self-managed third-party clients.

access.quote: To create an OAuth client, you must have one of these roles for the associated account: Super Administrator, Administrator, or OAuth Client Write.
